notes: Ask staff whether a teen needs a parent signature. The page does not say.
name: Volunteer in the Parks (City of Ann Arbor)
org: City of Ann Arbor Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Sign up for park projects such as the Huron River cleanup, Trash Trailblazers, Breeding Bird Survey, Adopt-a-Park and playground maintenance. Groups of 5 to 30 can request a project.
who_can_apply: The page says individuals and groups of all ages can volunteer. No minimum age is stated.
duration: One-day to long-term. Group projects run April to October.
deadline_text: No deadline. Event dates are on the online volunteer calendar.
how_to_apply: Individuals use the online volunteer calendar and sign-up. Groups submit the Group Volunteer Inquiry form. Email a2parksevents@a2gov.org or call 734.794.6627.
